citations.excerpt: Pope Gregory XI had left Avignon to return to Italy and had re-established the pontifical see in the Eternal City , where he died on 27 March, 1378.
On 11 November, 1417, the assembly elected Odo Colonna, who took the name of Martin V .
the division over the election to the Papacy of Urban VI. and Clement VII. as the “Great Schism of the West” (1378–1417)

facts.value: Division over the papal election of 1378 that produced rival claimants, ended by the election of Martin V.
